notes.title: Ad Playback Minor Fixed (Relaxed)
notes.content:
Considering the characteristics of Steam platform games,

we have slightly relaxed the conditions for ad playback.



 Before
- Everytime clicking "Continue"
- Every other time clicking "Retry"

After
- Everytime clicking "Continue"
- [strike]Every other time clicking "Retry"[/strike] (Removed)

Thank you.
